text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Geez, I can barely move...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whew... Okay!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Good luck in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was a good race... but that's
not all it
was.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
After this race,
I feel like Spe has gotten

everything she can get out of me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She's probably already thinking of her
next race,
about beating Grass.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Even though everyone's already
talented, they keep on working so hard.
The more they race, the
better they
become.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That means... I...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nah, forget it. It's not like I just had a
new
realization or anything.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I've been different from the start.
I never
had any
innate skills or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been using my head to
win. Pretty
obvious, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? About our next race... I
was
thinking about the Takarazuka
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's a Grand Prix race at the end of
the spring
season, held in Kansai.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think both Spe and Grass are gonna run
in it.
And there's something I wanna
confirm there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not a race I had in mind for her...
But looking
into Sky's determined eyes,
there's only one reply
I can give.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'm going to flip the script one
more time. I
can do it—I have to.
